chunks: And they took gods other than Allah, so that perhaps they would be helped.
ai.seo_question: What did the polytheists hope to gain by worshipping gods other than Allah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques the rationalization of Shirk, where polytheists attributed agency to idols based on perceived utility rather than divine essence. It underscores the futility of seeking intercession from created beings who lack independent power, a theme central to the concept of Tawhid al-Af'al. The verse serves as a reminder that true victory (Nasr) comes solely from Allah, contrasting human reliance on false deities with the ultimate support of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams.
